annotation.title_clean: Warning of the European Systemic Risk Board of 25 June 2026 on systemic cyber risks stemming from frontier artificial intelligence models (ESRB/2026/3)
annotation.title_en: Warning of the European Systemic Risk Board of 25 June 2026 on systemic cyber risks stemming from frontier artificial intelligence models (ESRB/2026/3)
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, C series
annotation.summary_en: ESRB general warning that frontier AI models with offensive cyber capabilities create systemic risk to the EU financial system by accelerating vulnerability discovery and exploit weaponisation. It urges authorities to integrate these risks into supervision, address asymmetries in access and resources, and coordinate with AI providers and others, with ESRB monitoring quarterly.
key_provisions_or_claims: Frontier AI models can discover vulnerabilities and weaponise exploits in minutes, collapsing defensive time buffers.
Risks to operational resilience span time, defender capability, provider concentration and authority capability.
Three asymmetries: between jurisdictions, attackers and defenders, and well- and poorly-resourced institutions.
Authorities should reflect FAIM risks in supervision, testing (TLPT, TIBER) and boards' governance under DORA.
ESRB will monitor FAIMs and reassess in quarterly risk assessments.
